<div class="hero-title" style="font-size: 2.2rem; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">CINAS Multi-Source Data Lake</div>
<div class="hero-subtitle" style="font-size: 1.15rem; margin-bottom: 1.5rem;">High-Performance Data Engineering for AI, Epidemiology, and Public Policy</div>

The **CINAS Data Lake** consolidates a unified data infrastructure of national public and governmental records in Brazil. Designed to overcome the fragmentation of health, demographic, and socioeconomic datasets, the platform powers cutting-edge research in Artificial Intelligence, spatial epidemiology, precision medicine, and resource allocation in radiation sciences and health.

The ecosystem rigorously follows the **Medallion Architecture**, isolating raw immutable sources (**Bronze Layer** with cryptographic SHA-256 validation), curated columnar datasets in **Apache Parquet with ZSTD compression** (**Silver Layer**), and a standardized transversal **Star Schema** with geospatial capabilities (**Gold Layer**), governed by a central ACID repository in **DuckDB**.
:::

## Strategic Axes & Integrated Providers {.mb-4}

The infrastructure transcends traditional hospital surveillance by articulating **seven major national data axes**:

::: {.grid .mb-5}

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .g-col-lg-4}
::: {.card .h-100 .shadow-sm .border-0 .p-3}
### {{< fa hospital >}} DATASUS
**Brazilian Ministry of Health (SUS)**
* **Hospital Inpatients (SIHSUS):** Reduced AIH (`RD`) and professional services (`SP`).
* **Outpatient Care (SIASUS):** Procedures (`PA`), bulletins (`BI`), and psychosocial care (`PS`).
* **Disease Surveillance (SINAN):** Compulsory notifiable diseases (Dengue, Chikungunya, Tuberculosis, etc.).
* **Healthcare Facilities (CNES):** 380k facilities and health teams.
* **Vital Statistics:** Mortality (SIM) and Live Births (SINASC).
* *Processing:* Lock-free conversion from legacy DBC and CSV formats to partitioned Parquet.
:::
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .g-col-lg-4}
::: {.card .h-100 .shadow-sm .border-0 .p-3}
### {{< fa cloud-sun >}} INMET
**National Institute of Meteorology**
* **Continuous Historical Records:** 2008 to 2026 with **84.4 million hourly observations**.
* **National Coverage:** 703 weather stations across all 27 Brazilian states.
* **Climatic Parameters:** 19 variables (extreme temperatures, precipitation, relative humidity, wind speed, solar radiation, pressure).
* *Application:* Distributed lag non-linear models (*DLNM*) correlating climate extremes with arbovirus outbreaks and respiratory diseases.
:::
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .g-col-lg-4}
::: {.card .h-100 .shadow-sm .border-0 .p-3}
### {{< fa users >}} IBGE & Demographics
**Brazilian Institute of Geography and Statistics**
* **Complete Census 2022:** 203 million audited population across 5,570 municipalities and 468k census sectors (13 thematic modules).
* **Projections 2000-2070:** Official demographic projections by single year of age and sex.
* **POPSVS Estimates:** 26-year annual intercensal series (2000 to 2025).
* *Application:* Standardized population denominators for epidemiological rates and demographic pyramids.
:::
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .g-col-lg-4}
::: {.card .h-100 .shadow-sm .border-0 .p-3}
### {{< fa shield-halved >}} ANS (Private Healthcare)
**National Supplementary Health Agency**
* **Elimination of Private Sector Blindness:** Over 25% of the Brazilian population covered by private healthcare plans.
* **CADOP:** 1,106 active operators registered with tax ID (CNPJ) and modality.
* **SIB (Beneficiaries):** 89.8 million active beneficiary links (medical and dental).
* **DIOPS (Financial & Claims):** 1.43 million accounting entries of healthcare claims and operating revenues.
:::
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .g-col-lg-4}
::: {.card .h-100 .shadow-sm .border-0 .p-3}
### {{< fa pills >}} CMED & ANVISA
**Pharmaceutical Market Regulation**
* **Pharmacoeconomics Catalog:** 25,701 standardized commercial presentations.
* **Maximum Consumer Price (PMC):** Factory price ceiling and state tax (ICMS) variations.
* **Government Procurement (PMVG / CAP):** Price ceiling for public healthcare acquisitions and Price Adjustment Coefficient (CAP).
:::
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .g-col-lg-4}
::: {.card .h-100 .shadow-sm .border-0 .p-3}
### {{< fa scale-balanced >}} IPEA / UNDP / FJP
**Social Vulnerability & Human Development**
* **Social Vulnerability Atlas (IVS):** 340k municipal records with 103 variables covering urban infrastructure, human capital, and income.
* **Municipal Human Development Atlas (IDHM):** Longevity, education, and income sub-indices.
* **São Paulo Dimension:** 100% coverage of all 645 municipalities in São Paulo state for social determinants control in oncology and nuclear medicine.
:::
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-12}
::: {.card .h-100 .shadow-sm .border-0 .p-3}
### {{< fa coins >}} SIOPS (Public Health Budgets)
**Brazilian Ministry of Health**
Monitoring of constitutional public health spending (ASPS - LC 141/2012) and municipal/state revenue allocations, allowing correlation of fiscal investment capacity with morbimortality outcomes.
:::
:::

:::

## Medallion Architecture & Data Engineering {.mb-4}

Storage topology organizes data into three strictly delimited maturity layers:

```
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                      BRONZE LAYER (Local Mirror)                       │
│  /datahome/datasets/mirror/{datasus, inmet, ibge, ans, anvisa, ipea...} │
│  • Immutable mirror of original files (.dbc, .csv, .zip)               │
│  • Cryptographic SHA-256 auditing in manifesto.duckdb                  │
└───────────────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────────────┘
                                    │ (Lock-Free Conversion Engines)
                                    ▼
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                      SILVER LAYER (Data Lake)                          │
│  /datahome/datasets/datalake/{datasus, inmet, ibge, ans, anvisa...}    │
│  • Standardized columnar Apache Parquet with ZSTD compression          │
│  • Analytical Hive partitioning (ESTADO=UF / ANO=YYYY / TEMA=...)      │
│  • Arrow semantic metadata injection (CINAS:versao_catalogo = 2.0)     │
│  • Strict physical mtime preservation matching mirror timestamps       │
└───────────────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────────────┘
                                    │
                                    ▼
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│               GOLD LAYER & TRANSVERSAL STAR SCHEMA                     │
│  /datahome/datasets/datalake/Dimensoes/ (Dimensional Tables)           │
│  • Universal domain lookup tables for sub-second JOINs in DuckDB       │
│  • DuckDB Spatial and GeoParquet support for spatial joins             │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

### Transversal Dimensional Catalog (Gold Layer)

Standardized dimensional tables in `/datahome/datasets/datalake/Dimensoes/` enable instant analytical enrichment without full-table scans of massive factual datasets:

| Dimensional Table | Scope / Contents | Records / Coverage |
| :--- | :--- | :---: |
| `dim_municipios.parquet` | Canonical IBGE municipality codes (6 and 7 digits, State, Region) | 5,570 municipalities |
| `dim_cid10.parquet` | International Statistical Classification of Diseases (WHO ICD-10) | 12,448 codes |
| `dim_sigtap.parquet` | Unified SUS Procedure and Medication Management System | 5,190 procedures |
| `dim_cbo.parquet` | Brazilian Classification of Health Occupations | 2,714 occupations |
| `dim_estabelecimentos.parquet` | Active National Healthcare Facilities Registry (CNES) | 380,000+ facilities |
| `dim_cmed.parquet` | Commercialized pharmaceuticals, active ingredient, PMC, PF, CAP | 25,701 presentations |
| `dim_estacoes_inmet.parquet` | Meteorological stations with WGS84 geographic coordinates and altitude | 672 stations |
| `dim_setores_censitarios.parquet`| Census 2022 enumeration sectors with urban/rural status and area | 468,099 sectors |
| `dim_populacao_municipios_ano.parquet`| Historical intercensal municipal population by age bracket and sex | 144,821 rows (2000-2025) |
| `dim_idhm_ivs_sp.parquet` | Social determinants of all 645 São Paulo municipalities (IDHM, IVS, Gini) | 645 municipalities (100% SP) |

## Centralized Governance & Lineage

The data lake is audited in real time by continuous governance components:
* **ACID Central Repository (`manifesto.duckdb`):** Tracks every mirrored file with MD5/SHA-256 hash, byte size, and remote collection timestamp.
* **Lock-Free Quarantine Model:** Dead Letter Queue and automated healing for corrupted files or schema shifts.
* **Human-Readable YAML Catalog:** Semantic dictionaries in `/src/metadados/` defining variables, types, and ontologies across all providers.
* **Temporal Lineage Preservation:** Synchronization routines that preserve the original source file *mtime*, guaranteeing digital forensics standards.
